summary: Iteration 17 — Verified the new 'Share this analysis' feature on the OD-Cashflow calculator end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (anon 401 on POST /api/calc/od-cashflow/share; demo create returns share_id+url+kind=odcf; public GET /api/shares/{id} returns kind/title/inputs/result with xirr_pct & monthly_series and does NOT leak user_id; unknown share id 404; anon 401 on /api/shares list; list includes odcf entry with xirr_pct & builder_plan; comparison-shape validated; non-owner admin DELETE 404; owner DELETE 200 then GET 404). Frontend: complete UI flow worked — demo-login → /app/calculators → tab-odcf → odcf-calculate → odcf-share → toast 'Link copied — send it to your spouse, CA, or broker' → odcf-share-result with full URL → odcf-share-copy works. Public share URL opened in fresh unauthenticated browser context renders share-odcf root, share-odcf-title='OD cashflow · ₹85,00,000 · 20_80', share-odcf-xirr='11.41%' (with %), 5 narrative bullets, line chart with 'Loan balance' and 'OD balance' legends, share-odcf-cta visible. Regression: SharedReport dispatcher (L71-73) routes data.kind==='odcf' to OdcfSharedReport while the existing comparison branch keeps data-testid='share-page' unchanged — verified by code review.

ui_bugs.issue: The inline copy handler `() => { navigator.clipboard?.writeText(shareUrl); toast.success('Link copied'); }` does NOT await the promise nor wrap it in try/catch. When clipboard write is rejected (e.g., document.hasFocus()===false in headless / iframe / focus loss), the unhandled rejection bubbles up and triggers the React dev-mode 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay (NotAllowedError: Failed to execute 'writeText' on 'Clipboard'). Users still see the success toast (misleading). The primary share() handler at L1563 already does this correctly — copy the same try/catch pattern.

Recharts logs warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on the public share page. The line chart for Loan/OD balance still renders visually but with unstable initial sizing — likely missing a fixed height or aspect on ResponsiveContainer wrapper. Cosmetic, not blocking.

action_items: Wrap odcf-share-copy onClick in try/catch (or use the existing share() pattern with `await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url).catch(()=>{})`) to suppress the dev-mode runtime error overlay when clipboard permission is denied. Also consider only showing the success toast after the await resolves.
Optional: give the OD-CF line chart's ResponsiveContainer an explicit height (e.g., h-72) on the public share page to silence the recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning.

rca of the issue: ui_bug #1 RCA: navigator.clipboard.writeText() returns a Promise. In the secondary copy handler (Calculators.jsx L1620), the call is fire-and-forget and unwrapped — when the browser denies the write (e.g., page lost focus during the test, no transient activation, or non-secure context), the rejected promise becomes an unhandledrejection event, which CRA's dev-overlay catches and renders as 'Uncaught runtime errors' over the page. Repro: open /app/calculators in two tabs, switch tabs, then click odcf-share-copy in the inactive tab. Mitigation: replace `navigator.clipboard?.writeText(shareUrl); toast.success(...)` with `try { await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(shareUrl); toast.success('Link copied'); } catch { toast.error('Couldn't copy — please copy the URL manually'); }` (and make the handler async).
